name: let binds a value
source:
tariff "t"
let x = 2
note "{x}"

name: let with an annotation
source:
tariff "t"
let x: Number = 2
note "{x}"

name: var accumulates
var subtracts
source:
tariff "t"
var left = 10
left -= 3
note "{left}"

name: var is reassigned
source:
tariff "t"
var x = 1
x = 5
note "{x}"

name: assigning a let is internal
source:
tariff "t"
let x = 1
x = 2

name: a var declared in a block stays in it
blocks are scopes
source:
tariff "t"
let x = 1
if true {
  let y = x + 1
  note "{y}"
}
note "{x}"

name: if runs the true branch
else runs when nothing holds
else if chains
if without else may run nothing
if let binds when present
if let runs else when none
for walks a list in order
for walks a half-open int range
for walks a closed int range
for over an empty range
for with where
break leaves the loop
continue skips to the next
break leaves only the innermost loop
require passes
source:
tariff "t"
require 1 < 2 else "never"
note "ok"

name: require refuses with the author's text
source:
tariff "t"
require shipment.hazmat else "Only hazmat loads, not {shipment.proNumber}"

name: require let binds for the rest of the block
source:
tariff "t"
require let p = shipment.pickup else "no pickup"
note "{p.kind}"

name: require let refuses on none
source:
tariff "t"
require let w = shipment.weight else "This rate needs the shipment's weight"

refusal.message: This rate needs the shipment's weight

name: fail refuses
source:
tariff "t"
note "before"
fail "No rate for {lane.origin.city}x"

name: fail inside a loop
refusal ranges point at the statement
source:
tariff "t"
let a = 1
fail "no"

name: a function with a block body
a function with an expression body
source:
tariff "t"
fn twice(x: Int) -> Int = x * 2
note "{twice(4)}"

name: a function default
source:
tariff "t"
fn fee(amount: Money = $95) -> Money = amount
note "{fee()} {fee($10)}"

name: named arguments in any order
a default may read an earlier parameter
source:
tariff "t"
fn pad(x: Int, y: Int = x + 1) -> Int = x + y
note "{pad(2)}"

name: functions call functions
source:
tariff "t"
fn a(x: Int) -> Int = b(x) + 1
fn b(x: Int) -> Int = x * 10
note "{a(2)}"

name: return leaves a function early
return from inside a loop
functions are closed over the record
source:
tariff "t"
fn peek() -> Text = shipment.proNumber
note "{peek()}"

name: functions cannot see file-level lets
source:
tariff "t"
let secret = 1
fn peek() -> Int = secret
note "{peek()}"

name: functions see constants
source:
tariff "t"
const BASE: Money = $3.50
fn base() -> Money = BASE
note "{base()}"

name: constants are evaluated from other constants
source:
tariff "t"
const BASE_A = 2
const DOUBLE = BASE_A * 21
note "{DOUBLE}"

name: a refusal inside a function points at the call
an error inside a library function is moved to the call
module aliases call module functions
source:
tariff "t"
use std.fuel
note "{fuel.stepPercent($3.20/gal, peg: $1.20/gal, step: $0.05/gal, perStep: 0.5%)}"

name: module aliases may be renamed
source:
tariff "t"
use std.ltl as l
note "{l.billed(1_240 lb)}"

name: imported types build records
source:
tariff "t"
use std.ltl.{ deficit, Break }
let breaks: List<Break> = [{ from: 0 lb, rate: $10/cwt, minimum: none }]
note "{deficit(breaks, actual: 120 lb).rate}"

name: user enums compare by variant
user record types
an expression statement runs
source:
tariff "t"
[1, 2].map(x => x)
note "ran"

name: a condition gives true
source:
condition "c"
lane.origin.zip3 in [""] and (shipment.weight ?? 0 lb) < 10_000 lb

name: a condition gives false
source:
condition "c"
shipment.hazmat

name: a condition with inputs and bindings
source:
condition "Residential delivery"
/// The zip3s this contract treats as residential.
input residentialZip3s: List<Text> = ["752"]
let zip = lane.destination.zip3
zip in residentialZip3s

name: a condition can refuse
source:
condition "c"
fail "no"
true

name: a library cannot be evaluated
source:
library "org.x"
fn x() -> Int = 1

name: a syntax error is a syntax error
source:
tariff "t"
let =

name: an unknown import is a syntax error
source:
tariff "t"
use std.nope

name: the wrong file kind is a syntax error
source:
condition "c"
true

name: notes interpolate and keep order
source:
tariff "t"
note "one {1 + 1}"
note "two"
